tom: Quick thread 1: customers (AcmeHealth & BetaCorp) are asking for per-tenant cost, error fingerprinting, and some trace signals before GA. Need a minimal, shipable surface.
elaine: Let's avoid full trace stitching. Propose a "visibility-lite": Tenant dashboard template, daily per-tenant cost CSV (exportable ledger), and a small gateway span with tenant/model/route tags.
priya: Dashboard should be a single-page template: requests/min, p50/p95, error-rate, cost sparkline, top 5 slow routes. Filters: tenant, model, last 24h. Keep widgets lightweight.
jon: Tracing: emit a short-lived span at the LLM gateway with tags tenant_id, model, route, token_count, sampling default 8%. No cross-service propagation for GA.
elaine: Error analytics: aggregate top error messages per-tenant with counts and example log link. Call out billing lag (~2h) in the UI and CSV header.
tom: Acceptance criteria: tenant dashboard in library; CSV export of daily token counts & cost estimate (accuracy within 7%); spans emitted with required tags and visible in traces UI; startup rollout via feature flag to BetaCorp then AcmeHealth; widgets load <1.2s for typical queries.
priya: Estimates: infra + billing glue ~2 dev-weeks; frontend ~1 dev-week; ops runbook ~1 day. Low perf risk if sampling kept low.
jon: Prioritization ask: if one thing this sprint, choose dashboards + CSV to unblock renewals. Tracing next sprint.
tom: Decision: sprint A = dashboards + cost CSV; sprint B = gateway spans + ops runbook. Action items: @priya mocks by Thu, @elaine infra ETA, @jon spike on sampling telemetry, @tom customer comms.
visibility-bot: RFC created: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/visibility-lite-ga :bookmark_tabs:
tom: I'll draft GA gates: dashboard availability >=99.5%, CSV daily accuracy <=7%, no >2x median latency regression for 95% of routes when sampling is enabled. Follow-up meeting scheduled. :thumbsup:
